name: ReadTaskRepeater
caption: Read task repeater

configuration.description: Exactly one SmartField placeholder '{{name}}' pointing to a Form task's repeater output ({{slug_section}}), one row of it ({{slug_section[2]}}), or a For Each currentItem / items over it. Read in its raw form.

Rows of { name, type: "value" | "reference", tableNo (reference only) } - the columns of the form task's repeater, one per field of the section in fields order. The editor copies them from the form task's repeater output (or a For Each over it) on save and refreshes them whenever another step is edited. Only these columns are read.
The repeater field's name (fields[].name of the Form task).
value, or reference for a record field.
reference columns: the record field's table (fields[].tableNo of the Form task).

outputs.name: <column name>
outputs.when: when at least one row was read - one per value column: the first row's value; {{slug_column[i]}} holds row i (0-based, not declared)

outputs.name: <column name>
outputs.when: when at least one row was read - one per reference column: the first row's record; {{slug_column[i]}} holds row i (0-based, not declared)

outputs.name: count
outputs.when: always - number of rows read; "0" when input resolved to nothing

rules.check: The configuration dialog refuses to save while the input is empty. (The step's own check 'Choose the repeater of a form task to read.' is not run.)
rules.message: Please fill in the highlighted fields.

rules.check: input resolves to values, or to records that are not SmartObjects (rows of a form task repeater, table 5564267) or no longer exist. %1 = the raw input. An input that resolves to nothing is not an error (count = "0").
rules.message: %1 is not a repeater of a form task. Choose the repeater output of a Form task step, or one row of it.

notes: Not gated itself, but only useful after a Form task, which is dark-launched (AutoFlow Tasks, portal feature flag 'tasks').
Typical use: For Each over {{formslug_section}}, then this step on the loop's currentItem, then the steps that use the row.
Read on the whole repeater, <column> is the first row only; use <column>[i] or a loop for the others.

The step's own check 'The step knows no columns of %1. Choose the repeater of a form task and save the step.' is not run: without columns the step only writes count. A column the form does not have reads as empty; a form field missing from columns is not read.
Output names are cut at 30 characters. Nothing is checked at publish time.
